animations.name: Strong Punch Low
animations.prompt: Fixed full-body 16-bit pixel art fighting-game side view, facing RIGHT. Start from the exact supplied low kneeling crouch guard pose. Perform ONE SINGLE brutal Luke-style compact MMA crouching uppercut across the clip (strictly one uppercut only, never twice), pure body motion only in empty air: staying low and compact on the baseline without standing tall, he drops his rear hip and right fist tight to his thigh, then drives ONE explosive, compact forward-upward MMA uppercut (~70 degrees) while keeping his left fist glued tightly in boxing guard by his cheek; brief apex, then smooth retraction back into the starting crouch guard pose. Preserve exact face, beard, flannel, jeans, boots, scale and pixel art. Keep the entire body and raised fist cleanly inside the 512x512 frame with margin on all edges. Locked camera, no zoom, no pan, clean sprite only.
